Summary: US11 - to set my weekly working days and hours
Description: As a doctor, I want to set my weekly working days and hours so that patients can only book slots when I am available.

Summary: US14 - to set the slot duration for each doctor
Description: As a hospital administrator, I want to set the slot duration for each doctor so that slots are generated correctly.

Summary: US01 - to search for doctors by specialty
Description: As a patient, I want to search for doctors by specialty so that I can find the right doctor.

Summary: US02 - to view a doctor's available time slots
Description: As a patient, I want to view a doctor's available time slots so that I can choose a convenient time.

Summary: US03 - to book an available time slot with a doctor
Description: As a patient, I want to book an available time slot with a doctor so that I can consult them at a convenient time.

Summary: US04 - to view my upcoming appointments
Description: As a patient, I want to view my upcoming appointments so that I can keep track of my visits.

Summary: US06 - to cancel a confirmed appointment up to 2 hours before its start time, after a conf
Description: As a patient, I want to cancel a confirmed appointment up to 2 hours before its start time, after a confirmation prompt, so that the doctor's time is not wasted.

Summary: US07 - a slot that was cancelled by another patient to show as available
Description: As a patient searching for a slot, I want a slot that was cancelled by another patient to show as available so that I can book it.

Summary: US05 - to choose a different available slot with the same doctor
Description: As a patient with a confirmed appointment, I want to choose a different available slot with the same doctor so that I can change my visit time.

Summary: US08 - to receive a reminder 24 hours before my appointment
Description: As a patient, I want to receive a reminder 24 hours before my appointment so that I do not miss it.

Summary: US10 - a confirmation notification after booking
Description: As a patient, I want a confirmation notification after booking so that I know my appointment is secured.

Summary: US12 - to block time for leave
Description: As a doctor, I want to block time for leave so that patients cannot book me while I am away.

Summary: US13 - to view my day's appointments
Description: As a doctor, I want to view my day's appointments so that I can prepare for consultations.

Summary: US09 - to choose push or SMS reminders
Description: As a patient, I want to choose push or SMS reminders so that I am reminded in the way I prefer.
